The internet broke after Carlos Alcaraz took off his shirt following a U.S. Open match.

SportsCenter posted the crowd’s response, women reached for their phones, and we discovered a remarkable new rule: the sexualization of a young athlete is only offensive when the athlete is female and the audience is male.

You don't get to condemn the male gaze and then celebrate the female one.

Real men protect women. Real women protect men.

Read the full op-ed: https://t.co/A0KYDRDRdA

When public safety is on the line, there is no room for gender delusion.

Our bill, the Gender Delusion Disqualification Act, would ensure individuals diagnosed with gender dysphoria cannot hold sensitive federal positions subject to mental health standards or obtain federal certifications requiring those same standards.

Serious positions require serious standards. We're not interested in lowering them to accommodate delusion.

You can't claim to oppose racism while running exclusive organizations based on race.

We introduced a resolution to end race-based caucuses in Congress. For decades, Congress has given official recognition to caucuses sorting Members by race and ethnicity.

This ends now.

Our resolution directs the House Administration Committee to revoke existing registrations and block future organizations from doing the same.

You represent ALL of your constituents. Not just the ones who look like you.

We are praying for the loved ones, fellow deputies, and everyone at the Charleston County Sheriff's Department grieving the loss of Deputy Michael Hendricks, who was killed in a line-of-duty tragedy yesterday.

Deputy Hendricks put on the badge to protect this community, and he gave everything doing it. 

May God give his family strength, peace, and comfort in the days ahead.

Rest in peace, Deputy Hendricks. Your sacrifice will never be forgotten💙
